AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized committee administrator account with full real-time read/write privileges.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator

email.description: Verified Google email of the administrator

addedByUid.description: UID of the admin who granted admin privileges

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted

CommitteeSettings.title: CommitteeSettings
CommitteeSettings.description: Vinayagar festival committee configuration for UPI collection, monthly deadline, and 5-day WhatsApp reminders.

festivalName.description: Name of the Vinayagar festival committee

upiId.description: Committee UPI VPA for receiving monthly contributions

upiPayeeName.description: Payee display name used in UPI deep links

defaultMonthlyAmount.description: Default monthly member contribution in INR

dueDayOfMonth.description: Day of the month (1-28) when contributions are due

reminderDaysBefore.description: Number of days before due date to send reminders (default 5)

whatsappMessageTemplate.description: Gentle WhatsApp reminder template with placeholders

autoReminderEnabled.description: Whether automated 5-day due reminder notifications are enabled

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last settings update

AdminSecurity.title: AdminSecurity
AdminSecurity.description: Admin-only secondary username and salted SHA-256 password/PIN lock configuration for the Admin Console.

lockEnabled.description: Whether the Admin Console requires username & password unlock

passcodeSalt.description: Random hex salt used for SHA-256 password hashing

passcodeHash.description: Hex SHA-256 digest of salt and admin password/PIN

updatedByUid.description: UID of the admin who updated the lock

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last security update

Member.title: Member
Member.description: Vinayagar festival monthly contributor record managed in real time by administrators.

email.description: Member Google email address for self-service payment access

emailLower.description: Lowercase normalized email for rule-enforced lookups

address.description: Street, house number, or ward note

userId.description: Linked Firebase Auth UID if associated

lastRemindedMonth.description: Last billing month (YYYY-MM) a WhatsApp reminder was sent, or empty

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when member was added

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when member was last modified

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Monthly contribution transaction recorded by admin or paid via UPI by an active member.

memberId.description: Document ID of the associated member

memberUserId.description: Denormalized Firebase Auth UID of the member

memberEmailLower.description: Denormalized lowercase email of the member

memberName.description: Denormalized full name of the member

upiRef.description: UPI transaction ID or UTR reference

notes.description: Optional payment notes or receipt remark

recordedByUid.description: UID of the user or admin who created the payment record

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when payment was recorded

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when payment was last modified

ReminderLog.title: ReminderLog
ReminderLog.description: Audit log of gentle WhatsApp payment reminders sent for a billing month.

billingMonth.description: Billing month (YYYY-MM) for which reminder was sent

sentByUid.description: Admin UID who initiated the reminder

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when reminder was logged

JoinRequest.title: JoinRequest
JoinRequest.description: Self-registration request submitted by a signed-in user waiting for admin approval into the members directory.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the requester

emailLower.description: Lowercase verified Google email of requester

phone.description: WhatsApp phone number provided by requester

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when request was submitted

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when request was updated

/settings/{settingId}.description: Committee configuration document (committee) and admin-only lock settings (admin_security)

/reminder_logs/{logId}.description: Audit log of WhatsApp payment reminders

/join_requests/{requestId}.description: Pending membership registration requests keyed by requester UID
